title: Distinct source and destination registers
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $s$ be a copy-phase state for the tape length parameter $M.k$. Assign source and destination registers to $s$ by the specified copy-phase rules. Then its source and destination registers are distinct, and neither is register $10$.
